scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run generate -w @telpen/database && npm run build -w @telpen/api && npm run build -w @telpen/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:domain && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @telpen/api" "npm run dev -w @telpen/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @telpen/domain && npm run typecheck -w @telpen/api && npm run typecheck -w @telpen/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @telpen/domain && npm run test -w @telpen/api
